name: exotic_mathematics

VINIT.justification: Initial state before any mathematical object is defined

TANCH.justification: Closed system boundary containing all mathematical operations

AFWD.justification: Constructive transformation building new surreal numbers

AREV.justification: Reverse analysis of propositions to derive contradictions

CLINK.justification: Chaining of mathematical operations to form complex structures

FSPLIT.justification: Splits a proposition into true and false verification paths

FFUSE.justification: Reconstitutes the original proposition after branch evaluation

EVALT.justification: Affirmative outcome where a proposition holds true

EVALF.justification: Negative outcome where a proposition's falsity is confirmed

ENGAGR.justification: Simultaneous true and false states in paradoxical systems

phase_3.void_description: Absence of defined mathematical objects or propositions
phase_3.false_description: Proposition refuted by counterexample or contradiction
phase_3.both_description: Paradoxical proposition holding both true and false values simultaneously

steps.domain_action: initialize the empty set as the starting state
establish the axiomatic foundation boundary
construct surreal number 0 via the empty set
construct surreal number 1 from prior elements
compose constructions to form surreal number 0.5
assert equality of 0.5 to itself
branch proposition '0.5 > 0' into true and false arms
in true arm, prove proposition using surreal order properties
validate the proof in the true arm
in false arm, assume proposition false and derive contradiction
confirm falsity assumption fails in false arm
fuse arms to conclude proposition is true
define self-referential proposition Q: 'Q is false'
recognize Q's self-referential identity
branch Q into true and false arms
in true arm, assume Q is true
in true arm, derive Q's falsity from its definition
hold both true and false states for Q in true arm
in false arm, assume Q is false
in false arm, derive Q's truth from its definition
hold both false and true states for Q in false arm
fuse arms to conclude Q is in a paradice state
publish results as permanent mathematical records

phase_5.compiler_frontend: mathematician's intuition formalized through logical calculus
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: axiomatic inference rules enabling deductive communication
phase_5.memory_mechanism: communal knowledge repository of theorems and proofs
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: dependency-ordering of proof steps based on logical priority

phase_6.post_cycle_state: resolved truth values and permanently recorded outcomes
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — logical reversibility preserves information except during irreversible fixation
